card.name: Patient already on another drug
card.fires_on: The word patient (or of, currently, already) just before a phrase saying the person is already taking or has another drug or condition. Seen in warnings about starting a drug in someone on a benzodiazepine, or using steroids with glaucoma.

modes.label: Patient before already-taking
modes.description: The word patient right after 'initiated in a', ahead of 'already taking' another drug.
modes.example: If an opioid analgesic is initiated in a<< patient>> already taking a benzodiazepine

modes.label: Linking word before existing condition
modes.description: Small words such as of or currently that lead into a coexisting condition or current therapy.
modes.example: Steroids should be used with caution in the presence<< of>> glaucoma.

card.writes: It seems to push toward outcome and success words and away from preliminary or expected words, which gives weak evidence of any clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the wording that introduces a patient who is already on another medicine or has another condition.
